main_text.p: li discretionem exercitatos habe-re, eoque ipso ratione uti ju-benti, injurium esse vident, aut fœdo semet ac pudendo Eutychianorum, aliorumque ante annos 1200. ab Ecclesia (dum fidem ejus audacius op-pugnarent) fulminatorum magisterio sive prudentes, si-ve imprudentes tradere erube-scunt. Putidis eorum adversus Catholicos cavillis ante annos plus minus centum abusus Al-*bertus Pighius * nulli suorum salivam moverat; sed longe post ejusdem elatum funus, in ipso fere sæculi decimi septi-mi limine, in Gallia nostra ex-orti Ioannes Gonterius Iesui-ta, Franciscus Veronus ex Ie-suita sæculo redditus presby-ter,

page.notes: Left margin note: "Pighii a. D. 1562" with a star mark; the star mark in the text after "Pighius" is a reference mark. Partly faded lines; the margin note is reconstructed from a worn print and is doubtful.
